title: The Vijñānabhairava: A Reference
claim: The whole Vijñānabhairava, 162 doors, decoded and translated line by line — a cheap exact reference to the text itself, with no one telling the reader what to do.

purpose.impact: The whole Vijñānabhairava in one sitting: 162 doors decoded, translated and left alone, so the reader meets the text rather than a teacher.
purpose.reader: The practitioner or scholar who wants the text itself, not a programme; the reader who suspects the instructions are already the recognition.
purpose.realisation: The techniques are not instructions to follow but recognitions to notice — the text is already looking back at the reader.
non_goals: no practice programme and no our-instruction layer
no selection of the 36 easiest doors

pages.note: 162 doors at 3/pp (54pp) + 9 block openers + front 10 + glossary 8 + index 6 + end 4 = 91, padded to 108. 400pp study edition only if full apparatus is added later.

sections_plan.purpose: doors 1–18, in the text’s own order
doors 19–36, in the text’s own order
doors 37–54, in the text’s own order
doors 55–72, in the text’s own order
doors 73–90, in the text’s own order
doors 91–108, in the text’s own order
doors 109–126, in the text’s own order
doors 127–144, in the text’s own order
doors 145–162, in the text’s own order

inclusion: all verses of the source, in order, set continuously at two to three per page
each chapter opens with a short argument placed from ARGMAP + C1, never newly written
glossary terms and definitions are placed from C1 key terms; index is generated
all 162 verses, in the text’s own order, with decoded Sanskrit and a sharp translation
one short interpretation note per verse at most; no practice programme
exclusion: no verse may be selected away to make room — the argument requires the whole set
no verse from this source may appear in another book
no facing-page commentary in the reference edition; that is the expanded edition's job
no selection — every door is printed
no our-instruction layer and no exercises
no verse reused in another book
